question: Contá los ensayos de fase 3 o fase 2/3 que prueban al menos un fármaco que actúa sobre el gen EGFR.

attempts.query:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.nct_id)
FROM aact.studies s
JOIN linking.trial_drug td ON td.nct_id = s.nct_id
JOIN linking.drug_target dt ON dt.parent_chembl_id = td.parent_chembl_id
JOIN linking.target_gene tg ON tg.target_chembl_id = dt.target_chembl_id
WHERE tg.gene_symbol = 'EGFR' AND s.phase IN ('PHASE3','PHASE2/PHASE3')
